export class Queue {
  #items=[];
  static #instances=0;
  constructor(name = "queue") {
    this.name = name;
    Queue.#instances++;
  }
  push(...values) {
    this.#items.push(...values);
    return this;
  }
  get size() {
    return this.#items.length;
  }
  * [Symbol.iterator]() {
    yield* this.#items;
  }
  async* drain(delay) {
    while (this.#items.length) {
      await delay();
      yield this.#items.shift();
    }
  }
  static get count() {
    return Queue.#instances;
  }
}

function unusedHelper() {
  return "never called";
}

const DEBUG = false;

export function process(input) {
  if (DEBUG) console.log("debug", input);
  const {a: a = 1, b: {c: c} = {}, ...rest} = input ?? {};
  const result = [ a, c ?? "none", Object.keys(rest).length ].map(x => typeof x === "number" ? x * 2 : x);
  label: for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    if (i === 1) continue label;
    result.push(i ** 2);
  }
  return result.length > 3 ? result : [ ...result, `count: ${result.length}` ];
}
